def factor_volume_weighted_reversal_robust(df):
    """Volume-weighted reversal with extended smoothing and no cross-sectional transform."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    ret = df_copy["close"] / df_copy["close"].shift(1) - 1.0
    is_high_vol, is_low_vol, vol_ratio = alpha_tools.classify_volume_regime(df_copy["volume"], window=20)
    weight = np.clip(vol_ratio, 0.5, 1.5)
    raw_signal = -ret * weight
    smoothed = raw_signal.ewm(span=10, min_periods=10).mean()
    df_copy["factor_volume_weighted_reversal_robust"] = smoothed
    return df_copy["factor_volume_weighted_reversal_robust"]
description: Mutation preserves the parent's volume-weighted reversal mechanism: daily return sign is inverted (mean-reversion) and scaled by a continuous volume ratio capped at [0.5, 1.5]. Two targeted changes are applied: (1) the smoothing span is extended from 5 to 10 bars to reduce noise and improve signal stability; (2) the cross-sectional transform is removed (set to 'none') to preserve raw payoff thickness, as evidence from similar candidates suggests that cs_rank can dilute top-quantile excess returns while the raw signal remains interpretable as a relative volume-weighted mean-reversion intensity.
